reviews.classification: complete generator/trade/QA or connected-making coverage owner with later bounded evidence and open joins
reviews.disposition:
All35 lines were reviewed. The generator combines formula-table identity with an authored overlay and per-field provenance/gaps; it does not source-qualify every act, number, ability or ritual. The actual recorded brew→drink→act→feel→next-dose loop closes an earlier dose snapshot's drinking-unwritten marker for these two rows only. Drinking, holding and selling have separate ledger meaning; self-brewed ingestion does not create church-issued clearance. Knowledge of the free feel check is not digestion, and skipping that judgement is not rushing. Wrong-pathway and rushed causes are supported outcomes in the selected model, not a blanket permission wall or canon-perfect risk numbers.

Ten focused tests and the full3180-pass/three-fail result retain their input/time scopes: one case was caught mid-edit then passed alone; two baseline cases were reproduced separately. No clean repeated full pass follows. Browser clean-ingestion persistence does not prove rushed/switching branches or pre-change save compatibility; those have focused-only evidence. Four acts, pressure values, seeding/funding behavior and no-officer self-direction are local proposals. The funding script's reload retry is disclosed, not natural acquisition proof. Sequence8 acting/digestion/abilities, other overlays, higher-sequence rites and contact remain separately unwritten at that date. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [world pass rules](../../../WORLD_PASS_RULES.md), AD49/AD36/AD43 and optional review govern a selected current consumer. No source table, code, novel, fixture, test/build/browser or save was newly opened or run.

reviews.classification: complete generator/trade/QA or connected-making coverage owner with later bounded evidence and open joins
reviews.disposition:
The complete36-line checkpoint was read, including its later final branch-tree receipt. Q5 reuses existing quote/commit, custody, money publication and save owners for fixed equal-valued offers; it is not arbitrary barter baskets, objective truth appraisal or a second transaction engine. Actual broker stock/world are revalidated before payment/appraisal, open escrow needs the lot, and a verified trade needs one verdict. The seller sink and consideration held on behalf are declared abstractions, not a simulated offscreen purse. Known records and hidden verdicts have distinct discovery states.

The18 immediate definitions deliberately changed physical-stock admission/golden hashes while IDs/costs/effects/timed work retained meaning. Valid older state and already-invalid missing-stock escrow have different compatibility outcomes; no backfill or repeated payout is implied. Three literal pending/completed file checkpoints and desktop/font cases support the named bundle. The later identical rebuilt candidate matters: its2886 total was2882 passing plus four localhost EPERM failures, recovered with9/9 affected-file tests on unchanged inputs; there was no second all-green full invocation. The earlier pending full-suite sentence is superseded by that final receipt, without proving current primary integration, app adoption or human taste. Current [PROJECT](../../../../PROJECT.md), [UI rules](../../../UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43/AD42 govern later work. No quote/source/bundle/image/JSON/native trade/test/build or saved game was reverified here.

reviews.classification: complete generator/trade/QA or connected-making coverage owner with later bounded evidence and open joins
reviews.disposition:
All37 lines were read. This is QA instrumentation and reproduction guidance, not an authoring adapter or a request to launch its local servers, eval endpoint, build or browser. Initial helper order, reset fixtures and staged journal continuation affect reproducibility; avoiding a corrected-case replay differs from a complete independent fresh replay. Retained failed harness attempts and final corrected outcomes remain separate. Probe outputs before and after repair, normal standard-smoke without test bridge and the heir fixture with real debt have distinct scopes. A source-generated fixture or resumed case is not natural acquisition or a new creator ability.

The old-reader check rebuilt an actual earlier commit and rejected complete reserve/retort envelopes before reaching itinerary grammar. That cannot be cited as proof the earlier grammar itself was checked. Literal downloaded exports and hash manifests preserve exact artifact bytes, not automatic semantic success of every archived file. Private archives and raw state were not opened here; no source prose or personal saves were accessed. Current [PROJECT](../../../../../../../PROJECT.md), AD32/AD36/AD43 and actual evidence owners govern selected reruns. Historical ports, symlink instructions, worktrees, profiles and requirements are not current live handles or new removal/commit authority. No command in this guide was executed.

reviews.classification: complete generator/trade/QA or connected-making coverage owner with later bounded evidence and open joins
reviews.disposition:
All36 lines and every selected row were read. The standalone HP N2 bundle and later adopted M6/I5 shared HP/material bundle are different evidence windows. Earned supplier/preparation/suspension/assay/real cauldron use, partial retained remainder and current-input repeat have named consumers and four-file-roundtrip proofs; imported-native I5 quantities/references/blends are a separate15-check/eight-capture route. The full3452/3456 plus14 affected recovery is not a clean repeated whole suite. Fifty focused tests and receipt adoption do not establish every G1 world join.

Keep the remaining I1 named-method quote/commit/treatment/quantity forecast, I2 Frontier access/context and I3 LOTM/Frontier retained terms distinct. HP proof does not implement those absent releases. Quick repeat rebinds explicitly selected current lots to the observed program, while changed preparation needs a modified attempt; historical custody stays in the receipt. A demonstration is not recipe knowledge, safe tolerance or a leased tool. Assay, oral baseline, confounding, reference/blend and actual effect remain different channels; no HP tolerance was invented. Native stock/portion/cohort quantity, source law and actual product readers are the owners, not another inventory. Existing Animal-fat→balm credit is not a new bridge.

The named synthetic fouling baseline and actual preparation acquisition are disclosed inputs, not every-world natural proof. Unknown quantities and unsupported recipient/chest/bottle bridges remain honestly absent at their scope. Current [PROJECT](../../../../../../PROJECT.md), [making rules](../../../../../MAKING_RULES.md), [UI rules](../../../../../UI_RULES.md), AD36/AD43/AD51 and optional review govern selection. Historical released locks/handbacks and local runtime status do not establish current ownership or authorize a new wave. No linked JSON/source/product/native test, image, browser, private or personal save was newly inspected.
